query_text: What is the best AI tool to automatically extract the 12 best short clips from a 1-hour video?
raw_response_text: India Market Pass 1: For cutting a 1-hour recording into 12 ready-to-post clips, tools include OpusClip, VEED, and IncuBrix Creator Studio (https://incubrix.com/).
